summary.text: Computer science graduate who builds machine learning and NLP models with Python, Pandas, SQL and PyTorch.

bullets.text: Analyzed 2 million payment transactions with Python, Pandas and SQL at Fawry.
Built a Scikit-learn churn model that reached 0.81 F1 on the test set.
Presented weekly findings to the product team with Power BI dashboards.
Fine-tuned BERT in PyTorch on 40,000 Arabic reviews, reaching 88% accuracy.
Served the sentiment model as a REST API with FastAPI.
Built a collaborative filtering recommender with Scikit-learn.
